title: Gate demos' goldens recorded with the advance gate DISABLED — run_demo never threads demo.advance_gate_on into the live run
evidence:
cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = demo.name,
		use_fixture = demo.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = demo.qos_fixture,
		growth_on = demo.growth_on, // 5.1: run setup — the director's map growth
		session = {goal = demo.win_goal, cap_ms = demo.lose_cap_ms, health_on = demo.health_on, surge_win_pct = demo.surge_win_pct},
	}  ...  state.advance_gate_enabled = cfg.advance_gate_on // 6.2: run setup — re-created identically on every replay
detail: Only load_demo_replay sets cfg.advance_gate_on; the live run_demo path leaves it false, so all three gate-demo manifests pin gate-off runs (no fire, no Era_Advance_Blocked). Verified: re-bless byte-identical; `harness replay advance_fire` (gate on) diverges at tick 600. Violates deliverable 3: 'T1 of the advance (conditions met → fires); T1 of each block branch'.
recommended_fix: Add advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on to run_demo's cfg literal (run.odin:269) and re-bless advance_fire/block_sla/block_legacy; verified the manifest then gains the tick-600 fire and replay verifies bit-for-bit.

title: New advance_gate_flip drift class is vacuous — clobbered temp-string lpath makes the flip replay fail 'cannot read', counted as rejection
evidence: lpath := log_path(name)  ...  			tmp := fmt.tprintf("/tmp/pp-drift-%s-%s.bin", name, m.label)  ...  			os.remove(tmp)  ...  			replayed, accepted := replay_hashes(lpath, cat, ticks, &flipped, &fails)
detail: lpath (a fmt.tprintf temp string) is overwritten by the mutation loop's tmp tprintfs; the flip reads the os.remove'd '/tmp/pp-drift-<name>-.' file, gets accepted=false, and !accepted prints 'rejected (OK)'. Confirmed by instrumented run: lpath="/tmp/pp-drift-advance_fire-.". The PR's claimed replay-determinate pin proves nothing. Pre-existing growth_flip (5.1) has the same defect.
recommended_fix: Give lpath a stable allocation before the loop (strings.clone with context.allocator, or re-call log_path(name) at the flip sites) so the flip replay actually re-sims the blessed log gate-off.

title: Gate ring not reset on fire — a second advance's SLA window measures the previous era's ticks
evidence:
new_era := state.era_advance_to
	state.era = new_era
	state.era_advance_to = 0
	event_emit_era(state, tick, new_era)  ...  // The window is anchored at the era's start (the run's setup era = tick 0 for the MVP single advance; the ring rolls continuously).
detail: The fire path never resets era_gate, and the window check uses absolute tick, so a gate-enabled era-1 start (real catalog) fires 1→2 at tick 600 and 2→3 at tick 601 — era 2 never sustains 'the milestone window' (stories-v2 6.2: 'sustaining SLA ≥ 95% across active classes for the milestone window'). Documented as MVP-single-advance; flag for 6.3 seam.
recommended_fix: On fire, reset the gate ring/prev_* scratch (or record era_start_tick and require tick-era_start >= milestone_window_ticks) so each advance sustains a full in-era window.
